title: The Sacramental Prayer
summary: An elder or priest ministers to the church. They kneel with the church and pray to the Father in the name of Christ, asking him to bless and sanctify the bread.

explicit_facts.text: An elder or priest ministered the flesh and blood of Christ to the church according to Christ’s commandments.
They knelt with the church and prayed to the Father in the name of Christ.
The prayer asks that the bread be blessed and sanctified for those who partake of it.

reasonable_visual_inferences: The people kneeling together form an assembled congregation.
Bread may be present during the prayer.
unspecified_visual_details: The number and appearance of the ministers and church members.
The location, clothing, furnishings, and appearance of the bread.

spoken_dialogue.text: O God, the Eternal Father, we ask thee in the name of thy Son, Jesus Christ, to bless and sanctify this bread to the souls of all those who partake of it;
spoken_dialogue.speaker: The elders and priests

narration.text: And they did kneel down with the church, and pray to the Father in the name of Christ, saying:

doctrinal_or_story_notes: The prayer connects partaking of the bread with remembering Christ’s body, taking his name, remembering him, keeping his commandments, and having his Spirit with them.
prohibited_inventions: Do not depict the Father or Christ as visibly present.
Do not assign an invented identity or setting to the praying group.
